title: Stopwatch
description: Build a stopwatch with start, stop, lap, and reset functionality.

steps.title: formatTime function
steps.description: Write `formatTime(ms)` that converts milliseconds to `HH:MM:SS.mm` format (e.g., 3661234 ms becomes `01:01:01.23`).
hints: Convert ms to total seconds with division
Compute hours, minutes, seconds, and hundredths
Pad each component with leading zeros

verification.failureMessage: Format should be HH:MM:SS.mm with leading zeros.

hints: Record Date.now() as the start time
Use setInterval to update elapsed time
Store the interval ID for stopping later
